# OINK

> A local-first Hugo theme for technical documentation

## Site index

- [Home page](http://localhost/index.md)
- [navigation.json](http://localhost/navigation.json)
- [Docs](http://localhost/docs/index.md): Build a technical content site. Use shared navigation, multilingual support, and search for documentation, blogs, books, and API references.
- [Book](http://localhost/book/index.md): Get a working OINK site from one prompt, then learn its features one layer at a time, from a single page to a published bilingual site.
- [Case](http://localhost/case/index.md): Seventy-nine real sites across third-party open-source projects, enterprise teams, personal blogs, books, and the PGSTY ecosystem built with Oink.
- [Blog](http://localhost/blog/index.md): Oink engineering notes, design stories, and reading shell guides
- [Release](http://localhost/release/index.md): Oink release notes, Hugo-only build requirements, and versioned upgrade history

## Documentation index

- [Introduction](http://localhost/docs/about/index.md): Decide whether OINK fits your project, what you get with it, how it differs from Docsy and MDX-based tools, and where it falls short.
  - [Highlights](http://localhost/docs/about/features/index.md): Look up what OINK adds to an ordinary Hugo theme, one capability at a time, with the setting that turns it on and a link to its guide.
  - [Cases](http://localhost/docs/about/showcase/index.md): Find the OINK production case closest to your documentation, book, blog, catalog, or community site.
  - [License](http://localhost/docs/about/license/index.md): Find which license covers the theme, this documentation and each bundled third-party runtime, and what you must keep when you reuse them.
  - [Contributing](http://localhost/docs/about/contributing/index.md): Report a problem or send a fix to the repository that owns it, with the checks a theme or documentation change needs before review.
- [Get started](http://localhost/docs/start/index.md): Clone the OINK docs site to run a full site locally in two minutes, then build your own personal or project site with an AI agent, from scratch, or inside a project's docs/ folder.
  - [Browse locally](http://localhost/docs/start/local/index.md): Clone an existing OINK repository and run hugo serve to read docs in your browser, preview edits as you type, and watch AI agents' latest reports render live.
  - [From scratch](http://localhost/docs/start/from-scratch/index.md): See what a minimal standalone OINK project looks like, build one from an empty directory, add OINK to an existing Hugo site, or install it without Go modules.
  - [Add docs to a project](http://localhost/docs/start/add-docs/index.md): Add a self-contained OINK documentation site inside an existing open-source repository's docs/ directory, keep build outputs out of Git, and wire GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages auto-builds.
- [Authoring](http://localhost/docs/write/index.md): Write documentation pages, blog posts, books, image albums, release pages and API references, and arrange them into a sidebar.
  - [Writing pages](http://localhost/docs/write/pages/index.md): Create a documentation page, from where the file goes and the front matter it needs to stable anchors, links, images, drafts and the controls the theme adds at the end.
  - [Organizing content](http://localhost/docs/write/organize/index.md): Arrange folders and `_index.md` files into the sidebar you want, then control order, section indexes, icons, folding, hidden pages and where documentation lives.
  - [Page parameters](http://localhost/docs/write/frontmatter/index.md): Look up every front matter key OINK reads, with its type, default and effect, to change one page or a whole section.
  - [Blog posts](http://localhost/docs/write/blog/index.md): Write blog posts with dates, bylines, series and featured images, then choose how the blog index, RSS feed and share bar present them.
  - [Books](http://localhost/docs/write/book/index.md): Turn a directory tree into a book with `type: book`: chapter numbering, numbered figures and tables, cross-references, generated indexes and whole-book print.
  - [Expo albums](http://localhost/docs/write/expo/index.md): Create an image album, add optional metadata, select a layout, and use the image viewer.
  - [Releases and downloads](http://localhost/docs/write/releases/index.md): Publish a release page with a GitHub release card, a checksummed asset table and install instructions, all built from facts kept in your repository.
  - [API reference](http://localhost/docs/write/openapi/index.md): Render an OpenAPI specification as a browsable API reference with the bundled Swagger UI or Redoc, without a CDN.
- [Components](http://localhost/docs/components/index.md): Pick the component that fits what you are writing and look up its shortest syntax, its form and whether it loads a script.
  - [Callouts](http://localhost/docs/components/callout/index.md): Write notes, warnings, and collapsible asides with colors, icons, and titles. Use `> [!NOTE]` blockquotes without shortcodes.
  - [Code Blocks](http://localhost/docs/components/code/index.md): Show commands, configuration and source code in a Markdown fence with a filename, exact copying, line numbers, highlighting, wrapping, folding and linkable lines.
  - [Tables](http://localhost/docs/components/table/index.md): Turn an ordinary Markdown table into a captioned table, a compatibility matrix, a field list, a numbered book table or a tab set, and give wide technical tables room to read.
  - [Fields](http://localhost/docs/components/fields/index.md): Document configuration keys, command flags and API fields as a field list that stays readable on a phone and gives every entry its own link.
  - [Badge](http://localhost/docs/components/badge/index.md): Mark a feature, version or table cell with a short status label such as Beta or deprecated, in one of five semantic tones.
  - [Kbd](http://localhost/docs/components/kbd/index.md): Use `kbd` with one key name per parameter to display a semantic key sequence. Instructions remain readable in print and Markdown.
  - [Tabs](http://localhost/docs/components/tabs/index.md): Put equivalent alternatives such as package managers or config formats side by side, and let one reader choice follow them across every page.
  - [Steps](http://localhost/docs/components/steps/index.md): Add `{.steps}` to an ordered list for a numbered procedure. Use the steps shortcode when each step needs a table-of-contents heading.
  - [Timeline](http://localhost/docs/components/timeline/index.md): Turn a Markdown definition list into a vertical timeline of dated or ordered events, for milestones, incident write-ups, product history or an agenda.
  - [Update](http://localhost/docs/components/update/index.md): Write a changelog, a "What's new" page or weekly notes as ordinary headings marked `{.update}`, with an optional date and tags under each entry.
  - [Cards](http://localhost/docs/components/cards/index.md): Turn a Markdown link list into a grid of navigation cards, and use the shortcode when cards need icons, badges or images.
  - [Includes](http://localhost/docs/components/include/index.md): Reuse one source across pages with include for shared fragments and files, param for site and page values, and comment for notes that never publish.
  - [Mermaid](http://localhost/docs/components/mermaid/index.md): Use a `mermaid` fence for flowcharts, sequence diagrams, Gantt charts, class diagrams, and state diagrams. Bundled Mermaid follows the color scheme; source diffs show changes.
  - [PlantUML](http://localhost/docs/components/plantuml/index.md): Render sequence, class, component, activity and use-case diagrams in the browser with bundled assets and no rendering service.
  - [Draw.io](http://localhost/docs/components/drawio/index.md): Publish a Draw.io export as an ordinary image that readers can open in the Draw.io editor, change and download.
  - [ECharts](http://localhost/docs/components/echarts/index.md): Draw bar, line and pie charts by writing ECharts options as YAML or JSON in an `echarts` fence, with colors that follow light and dark mode.
  - [Infographic](http://localhost/docs/components/infographic/index.md): Turn a title and a short list of items into a flow, timeline, funnel, grid or hierarchy graphic with an `infographic` fence and an AntV template.
  - [Maps](http://localhost/docs/components/map/index.md): List places in a `map` fence to get a numbered place list in HTML, Print and RSS, plus an interactive map once the site names a tile service.
  - [Markmap](http://localhost/docs/components/markmap/index.md): Use a `markmap` fence for an expandable mind map with zoom controls. Its source remains a readable Markdown outline.
  - [FileTree](http://localhost/docs/components/filetree/index.md): Draw an annotated directory tree in a `filetree` fence, with aligned comments, per-entry icons and collapsible directories.
  - [Math](http://localhost/docs/components/math/index.md): Use KaTeX for inline and display mathematics at build time. Readers download no script.
  - [Images](http://localhost/docs/components/image/index.md): Add images with plain Markdown, then use one attribute line for a caption, a size, zoom, a link, a figure number or Hugo image processing.
  - [Gallery](http://localhost/docs/components/gallery/index.md): Lay out a set of related screenshots as a responsive grid with a `gallery` fence, each with an optional description or link.
  - [Video](http://localhost/docs/components/video/index.md): Embed product demos, screen recordings and muted loops that replace GIFs, and link YouTube, Bilibili or Vimeo talks without contacting the platform until a reader clicks.
  - [Audio](http://localhost/docs/components/audio/index.md): Put a podcast episode, voice sample or recorded talk on a page with image syntax, as a titled native player with its transcript beside it.
  - [Asciinema](http://localhost/docs/components/asciinema/index.md): Embed a .cast terminal recording that readers can play, pause and copy text from, with the player shipped in the theme.
  - [Social](http://localhost/docs/components/social/index.md): Quote a post from X, Bluesky, Mastodon, or another platform with a `> [!SOCIAL]` callout. The page supplies the quote and attribution without a platform script, and plain Markdown viewers show an ordinary blockquote.
  - [Presentation](http://localhost/docs/components/presentation/index.md): Cards, disclosures, tabs, and compact procedures across OINK's four visual presets.
- [Customization](http://localhost/docs/customize/index.md): Configure the site brand, navigation, layout, search, languages, versions, print output, and agent output.
  - [Configuration](http://localhost/docs/customize/config/index.md): Find every site parameter that the theme reads, with its type, default, description, and related guide.
  - [Brand and appearance](http://localhost/docs/customize/brand/index.md): Give the site your name, logo, favicon, accent color and fonts, choose a visual preset, and add your own CSS.
  - [Home and landing pages](http://localhost/docs/customize/home/index.md): Build the home page, or any product or pricing page, from sections listed in a YAML data file, with no template to write.
  - [Navigation and menus](http://localhost/docs/customize/navigation/index.md): Configure the navbar menu, dropdowns, section switcher, breadcrumbs, page actions, pager, and footer links.
  - [Layouts and page types](http://localhost/docs/customize/layout/index.md): Choose which shell a page renders in, and tune its sidebar, table of contents, section index and page width.
  - [Search](http://localhost/docs/customize/search/index.md): Add full-text search that runs in the reader's browser, and control what it indexes and how it ranks results.
  - [Command palette](http://localhost/docs/customize/panel/index.md): Use one dialog for page search, page actions, and site commands. Open the palette, use its groups, and add custom commands.
  - [Keyboard navigation](http://localhost/docs/customize/keyboard/index.md): Use single-key shortcuts and understand when typing disables them. Disable shortcuts for the site or individual pages.
  - [Languages](http://localhost/docs/customize/i18n/index.md): Add a second language end to end, keep heading anchors aligned across translations, and let readers compare two languages side by side.
  - [Versions](http://localhost/docs/customize/versions/index.md): Publish documentation for several product versions side by side, with a version switcher and a banner that marks unmaintained versions as archives.
  - [Taxonomies](http://localhost/docs/customize/taxonomy/index.md): Use tags and categories to index pages across directories, with automatic term pages, term cards, rail clouds, and navbar panels.
  - [Repository links](http://localhost/docs/customize/repository/index.md): Connect "edit this page", "open an issue", and "view history" to your repository. Show last-modified information, contributors, and feedback at the page end.
  - [Print](http://localhost/docs/customize/print/index.md): Print one page with the browser's Cmd/Ctrl+P. Use the print output format to combine a section into one continuous document.
  - [AI-agent support](http://localhost/docs/customize/agents/index.md): Publish a Markdown copy of every page and an `llms.txt` index, so AI agents and chat assistants can read the site without scraping its HTML.
- [Operations](http://localhost/docs/admin/index.md): Take a finished site from your machine to a live address and keep it running there.
  - [Local preview](http://localhost/docs/admin/preview/index.md): Watch your changes render as you save with hugo server, then build the public/ directory you deploy.
  - [Deploy](http://localhost/docs/admin/deploy/index.md): Publish public/ to GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages or any static host, with the right baseURL, CI settings, security policy, checks and rollback.
  - [Comments](http://localhost/docs/admin/comments/index.md): Add a comment thread to each page with giscus and GitHub Discussions, choose which pages carry one, and match it to the site's colors.
  - [Analytics and SEO](http://localhost/docs/admin/analytics/index.md): Connect Google Analytics or another service if you want visit counts, and check the canonical, hreflang, social-card, sitemap and robots output search engines read.
  - [Upgrade](http://localhost/docs/admin/upgrade/index.md): Move a site to a newer OINK release, or migrate it from OINK 0.4 or Docsy, with a rollback path at every step.
  - [Troubleshooting](http://localhost/docs/admin/troubleshooting/index.md): Find the cause and fix of a build, language, search or hosting problem from its symptom, and check a site before you publish it.
- [Design](http://localhost/docs/design/index.md): OINK's contracts, accepted decisions, dated research, and active proposals in one bilingual section.
  - [Architecture](http://localhost/docs/design/architecture/index.md): Repository assembly, configuration, diagnostics, localization, output, performance, security, CSS, accessibility, and release-state boundaries.
  - [Diagnostics](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/diagnostics/index.md): Invalid input produces visible warnings and safe fallbacks. Checks verify diagnostics and rendered output without aborting on every warning.
  - [Goldmark attributes](http://localhost/docs/design/research/goldmark-attributes/index.md): Repeatable probes of lists, images, tables, passthrough blocks, fences, callouts, and nested containers on Hugo 0.160.1 and 0.164.0.
  - [Knowledge graph](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/knowledge-graph/index.md): A draft three-stage design to generate backlinks and local or global graph views from ordinary Hugo links.
  - [2026-10-18 build baseline](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-18-consumer-baseline/index.md): Local inventory of 37 maintained OINK sites using v1.3.2 and Hugo Extended 0.168.0, with visible warnings and separate publication evidence.
  - [Ink / Terminal experiment](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-05-ink-terminal-experiment/index.md): Explicit experimental presets in real theme output, their design tradeoffs, checks and remaining work.
  - [Local search engine](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/local-search-engine/index.md): A draft that replaces Lunr with one scanning engine, ranks by BM25, and reads CJK text by script instead of by language tag.
  - [OINK 1.2 pre-release review](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-05-v1-2-release-review/index.md): Local 1.2.0 candidate review, cleanup, compatibility, resource provenance and publication checks, with release boundaries.
  - [Preset acceptance](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-05-visual-presets-acceptance/index.md): Local Paper and Slate verification, real theme output, and bounded browser evidence.
  - [Components](http://localhost/docs/design/components/index.md): The maintainer contract for OINK authoring primitives, validation, Book and release behavior, and output degradation.
  - [Configuration](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/configuration/index.md): Hugo and Docsy-compatible configuration, with a narrow OINK interface and no parallel configuration namespace or global resolver.
  - [Consumer evidence](http://localhost/docs/design/research/consumer-evidence/index.md): A dated consumer corpus survey that informed OINK shells, authoring primitives, and deterministic Book migration rules.
  - [Media convergence](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/media-convergence/index.md): A draft for the remaining convergence between content images, numbered figures, Landing media, and featured-image selection.
  - [Theme roadmap](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/theme-roadmap/index.md): A draft roadmap that puts leaving Hugo's removed LibSass first, then closes small reader gaps, version lifecycle, and a static API reference.
  - [Content components expansion](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/content-components-expansion/index.md): The reviewed plan for six new content components (Timeline, Update, offline X, Video, Audio, and Map), the shared decisions behind them, and their delivery order.
  - [Timeline component](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/component-timeline/index.md): A native definition-list timeline for dated or ordered events in prose, with no shortcode and no runtime.
  - [Update component](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/component-update/index.md): Changelog entries as ordinary headings marked .update, with a date and tags, so every entry joins the outline, search, and Print without a shortcode.
  - [Audio component](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/component-audio/index.md): Audio through ordinary Markdown image syntax — a labeled native player for podcasts, voice samples, and recordings, with transcripts in a folded callout and shared single-active playback when multiple players appear on a page.
  - [Video component](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/component-video/index.md): Video through ordinary Markdown image syntax — local or object-storage files, muted looping demos that replace GIFs, and privacy-first cards for YouTube, Bilibili, and Vimeo.
  - [Map component](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/component-map/index.md): A map data fence whose place list is always the content, progressively enhanced with an opt-in OpenStreetMap-ecosystem map through vendored Leaflet and a site-chosen tile service.
  - [Social post component](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/component-social/index.md): A static, offline card for quoting a post from X or another social platform, written as a `> [!SOCIAL]` callout — author, handle, avatar, date, link, and a Markdown body — with no build-time fetch and no runtime.
  - [2026-08-26 review](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-08-26-comprehensive-review/index.md): Evidence-based review of post-v0.7.0 implementation, configuration, outputs, security, tests, performance, bilingual contracts, and the real integration site.
  - [CLI and roadmap](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/oink-cli-roadmap/index.md): The accepted independent CLI boundary and local first-stage scope, with later adoption, theme, migration, and content-model work still proposed.
  - [Markdown-first authoring](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/authoring/index.md): Native Markdown carries common semantics, shortcodes fill capability gaps, and new content models extend shared shells.
  - [Shell and navigation](http://localhost/docs/design/shell/index.md): Navigation authorities, immersive blog presentation, search, actions, taxonomies, indexes, and page-end composition.
  - [CLI maintenance](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/oink-cli-maintenance-roadmap/index.md): Historical R1–R8 requirements for documentation maintenance and Oink Studio, distinct from acceptance evidence and the current reduced CLI contract.
  - [2026-09-19 community review](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-09-19-upstream-review/index.md): Evidence, acceptance advice, and focused remedies for community issues 40, 41, 42, 44 and pull request 43.
  - [Config schema](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/config-schema/index.md): Editor schemas generated from existing configuration sources, with a CI gate that prevents drift.
  - [Landing pages](http://localhost/docs/design/landing/index.md): The maintainer contract for landing data, the built-in section registry, language resolution, runtime, accessibility, and outputs.
  - [Visual presets](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/visual-presets/index.md): Paper and Slate ship in 1.2.0; Ink and Terminal are explicitly enabled experiments awaiting design acceptance.
  - [Expo](http://localhost/docs/design/expo/index.md): Define album resources, display modes, image viewing, shared appearance, and static outputs.
  - [2026-09-20 release review](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-09-20-release-review/index.md): Five reproduced runtime defects, documentation corrections, validation evidence, and the OINK 1.1 publication follow-up.
  - [CLI contract](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/cli/index.md): Executable ownership, versioned diagnostics, isolated validation, and guarded maintenance plans for the current local CLI candidate.
  - [Component refinement](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/component-refinement/index.md): Consistent component surfaces and controls, with three optional Markdown presentation variants.
  - [Migration boundary](http://localhost/docs/design/migration/index.md): Supported source, configuration, and validation boundaries for OINK migration, including the 1.6.0 and 1.7.0 upgrades.
  - [Visual presets](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/visual-presets/index.md): Accepted phase-one visual identity and appearance controls, with separate reader style and mode state.
  - [2026-10-03 CLI maintenance](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-03-cli-maintenance-acceptance/index.md): Dated source and binary evidence for the local R1–R8/A18 program, preserving the initial audit, failed trials, and final acceptance scope.
  - [2026-10-03 CLI maintenance · R1–R5](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-03-cli-maintenance-acceptance-r1-r5/index.md): R1–R5 local validation and acceptance evidence from the dated CLI maintenance record.
  - [2026-10-03 CLI maintenance · R6–R8](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-03-cli-maintenance-acceptance-r6-r8/index.md): R6–R8 and A18 workspace, Studio, editing and runtime evidence from the dated CLI maintenance record.
  - [Document comparison research](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-29-document-comparison/index.md): Dated evidence for a generic OINK side-by-side reading mode across languages and revisions.
  - [2026-09-29 CLI acceptance](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-09-29-cli-acceptance/index.md): Executed Starter, real-site, offline, upgrade, and reproducible-archive checks for the local CLI candidate.
  - [Expo albums](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/expo/index.md): Record the reasons for album bundles, shared appearance, three display modes, and the image viewer.
  - [Ink and Terminal stabilization](http://localhost/docs/design/proposals/ink-terminal-stabilization/index.md): A conditional stabilization plan for two distinct reading styles, with a shared footer blocker and explicit bilingual accessibility gates.
  - [Blog gallery](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/blog-gallery/index.md): Keep articles as the content model while reusing Expo geometry for a fourth blog index view.
  - [Component refinement review](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-25-component-refinement/index.md): Local four-preset component validation, asset measurements, and separately reproduced gallery baseline failures.
  - [Table reading](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/large-table-reading/index.md): Separate technical table layout from an optional corner action for reading in a larger viewport.
  - [v1.5.0 review repairs](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-11-06-review-repairs/index.md): Reproduced build, feed, navigation and interaction defects, bounded repairs, and remaining review work.
  - [Ink and Terminal review](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-26-ink-terminal-stabilization/index.md): Source review, bounded visual evidence, current failures and promotion limits for Ink and Terminal on 2026-10-26.
  - [Translation comparison](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/document-comparison/index.md): Compare a page with an existing same-origin translation in a two-pane reader that loads only when asked.
  - [1.5.1 readiness review](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-11-06-v1-5-1-release-review/index.md): Three reproduced candidate regressions, complete browser acceptance, and remaining publication gates.
  - [Keyboard map](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/keyboard-map/index.md): Record why OINK binds twenty-nine single-key shortcuts in three groups, dims what a page cannot run, and adds local history, fold-all, and a reader width.
  - [Dependency acceptance](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-11-11-dependency-acceptance/index.md): Functional, failure-path and browser acceptance of the local dependency migration after OINK 1.5.1.
  - [2026-10-13 theme review](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-13-theme-review/index.md): Reproduced image escaping and interaction defects, their repairs, and local theme and consumer validation.
  - [Large-table reading research](http://localhost/docs/design/research/2026-10-26-large-table-reading/index.md): Framework and component evidence, measured reading concepts, and a bounded direction for OINK technical tables.
  - [Unified diagram reading](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/diagram-reading/index.md): Shared Mermaid and local PlantUML viewing, source export and demand loading.
  - [Local search](http://localhost/docs/design/decisions/local-search/index.md): Mixed-language queries, technical identifiers, section results, and palette scope in OINK 1.4.0.
- [CLI](http://localhost/docs/cli/index.md): Learn what the optional OINK command-line tool does and how to build its unreleased local candidate.
